input_source.user_report: Archived recovery failed after closeout archive because archived worklog refs kept active workset prefixes.
input_source.followup_goal: Find the systemic root cause and prevent future recurrence.

prior_findings.finding: The helper copied active-workset-prefixed refs into archived worklog.md; archived recovery resolves refs relative to the archive directory.

observations.evidence: tools/community/recover_context.py:50-57 uses archive_ref as feature_dir for archived entries, then parses archive/worklog.md.
tools/community/recover_context.py:130-132 resolves small-chain archived state_ref and next_ref relative to that archive feature_dir.
tools/community/validate_context_contract.py:134-140 previously only checked archive_ref existence for legacy entries, so bad archived worklog refs were not blocked by the general validator.
community/superpowers/skills/archive/SKILL.md:75-76 requires archived worklog handoff refs to remain parseable.

hypotheses.evidence: A regression fixture with legacy archive_ref and state_ref 2026-04-25-small/tasks.md#T1 passed before the validator change, proving the validator did not inspect archived worklog refs.
The archive skill contract already stated archived worklog refs must parse, and recover_context enforced that path; the missing layer was mechanical validator coverage, not the intended skill flow.

root_cause.cause: validate_legacy_entry treated archive_ref reachability as sufficient and did not validate the archived worklog entry, while recover_context later consumed that same worklog and resolved refs relative to the archive directory.

fix.summary: Legacy entries now validate archive-local worklog required fields and refs through the shared validate_worklog_at path. Archived small-chain task/plan consistency also supports archive-root tasks.md and plan.md.

red_green_evidence.result: failed with [FAIL] unreachable archived worklog ref should fail before validator enforcement was added

regression_evidence: python3 tools/community/recover_context.py --repo-root . --feature docs/feature--small-chain--automation --archived -> resolved archived worklog with state_ref verify-change-report.md
bash tools/validate-contracts.sh -> OK: all checks passed
scope_note: tests/run-all.sh was started and reached install migration before the user stopped it as too broad for this impact area. The final proving set is scoped to context validation, archived recovery, closeout automation, contracts, syntax, shell lint, and diff hygiene.
